observations: A large rounded head outlined in thick black lines fills the center, with multicolored streaks—light blue, green, yellow, pink—radiating outward from behind it across the full background.
Two asymmetric eyes sit at different heights: the left has jagged yellow-orange lash marks above a triangular yellow iris, while the right is smaller with similar lashes and a narrow opening.
A wide open mouth in the lower left of the face shows yellow-brown teeth between dark lips, and white brushstrokes trace the chin and jaw, forming a loose secondary contour.
reading: The face floats against a burst of pale rays pushing outward to every edge, lending the composition a sense of pressure from behind the figure. Warm orange and brown tones pool across the left cheek and forehead, while cool blue washes dominate the right side, splitting the face into contrasting temperatures. The uneven eyes and bared teeth can read as startled or confrontational—an expression caught mid-shift rather than settled.
contextAngle: Within the owned rawblocks subset, this work sits between "nnxyz rawblocks #14" and "nnxyz rawblocks #16." Those neighbors share solid olive backgrounds and defined eyewear, while #15 replaces both with radiating color streaks and exposed, unshielded eyes—a notable structural departure.

connections.reason: Both center a single rounded head with multicolored skin patches, but #14 uses a flat olive ground and opaque sunglasses while #15 strips the eyes bare and replaces the background with radiating lines.
Both share a light blue field and jagged black outlines around facial features, though nnotb #1 fills the frame with overlapping figures and dense line tangles rather than a single isolated head.

lookingQuestion: How does the split between warm tones on the left side of the face and cool blue on the right change the way you read the expression formed by the mouth and eyes?
ambiguities: Faint letter-like shapes appear in the upper-right area behind the head, but they are too obscured by the radiating streaks to confirm as readable text or a signature.
A thin blue line descends from the forehead between the eyes; it is unclear whether this is a separate mark or part of the background rays passing through the face.

imageReview.method: Original PNG supplied to separate multimodal drafting and review calls
